faq: Will the content sound like us?

That is the aim. We study your samples, write down your tone, favourite phrases and words to avoid, and test the drafts against them. You review the first batch with us and we adjust until it reads like you.
Is AI-drafted content fine for search engines?
Search engines focus on whether content is helpful, not how a draft was made. We build review steps so a person edits and adds real facts before publishing. Rankings cannot be promised.
No. We never generate reviews or testimonials, because that breaks platform rules and consumer law in many places. We can draft review request emails or replies to real reviews, which you approve.
